name: print-social-luxury-property-flyer-collage-mockup
title: Real-estate flyer collage: skyscraper photo, contact footer and stacked mockups
whatItIs: A collage: at left a large dusk photo of a glass tower with headline 'LUXURY HOMES' in white serif, a subhead, a paragraph and a row of interior photos with contact details; at right three mockups of the flyer on white desk with leaves and a coffee, on grey and on tan paper.
whatItMeans: Premium and aspirational; the deep blue dusk and glowing windows suggest high-end living.
techniques: Use a dramatic dusk tower photo as a full-height backdrop.
Set the headline in a light serif in white.
Add a strip of small interior photos as proof.
Show the flyer on several surfaces to prove print flexibility.

vocabulary.definition: Photos taken at twilight with lit windows.
A row of small images along an edge.
A presentation of a flyer on a realistic surface.
A bottom band with phone and web details.
